# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in FixitBhai, please **do not** open a public issue.

Instead, please report security issues privately through [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/ShashankS1011/FixitBhai/security/advisories/new) or contact the maintainer directly.

### What to include in your report:
- Type of issue (e.g., insecure data storage, secret exposure, authorization issue)
- Step-by-step instructions or proof-of-concept to reproduce the vulnerability
- Potential impact of the issue

We take security seriously and will acknowledge, investigate, and address all valid reports promptly.
